title: [dynamo] Codegen error when Python code has local and cell with same name
bug_description:
```python
import torch

keys = range(10)
allowed = [0, 1, 2, 3]


def fn(x):
    x = x + 1
    torch._dynamo.graph_break()
    key = [key for key in keys if key in allowed]

    def inner():
        nonlocal key

    return x + key[0]


torch.compile(fn, backend="eager")(torch.ones(3))
```
gives error
```
...
  File "/data/users/williamwen/pytorch/torch/_dynamo/resume_execution.py", line 296, in lookup
    cls.cache[code][key] = cls.generate(code, lineno, *key)
                           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/data/users/williamwen/pytorch/torch/_dynamo/resume_execution.py", line 505, in generate
    new_code, _ = transform_code_object(code, update)
                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/data/users/williamwen/pytorch/torch/_dynamo/bytecode_transformation.py", line 1469, in transform_code_object
    _, bytecode = clean_and_assemble_instructions(instructions, keys, code_options)
                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/data/users/williamwen/pytorch/torch/_dynamo/bytecode_transformation.py", line 1485, in clean_and_assemble_instructions
    fix_vars(instructions, code_options, varname_from_oparg=varname_from_oparg)
  File "/data/users/williamwen/pytorch/torch/_dynamo/bytecode_transformation.py", line 1379, in fix_vars
    instructions[i].arg = varnames[instructions[i].argval]
                          ~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
torch._dynamo.exc.InternalTorchDynamoError: KeyError: key

from user code:
   File "/data/users/williamwen/pytorch/playground3.py", line 11, in fn
    torch._dynamo.graph_break()
```

This is because the original code refers to `key` as both a cell and a local variable, but the resume function revers to `key` only as a free variable.

This was discovered due to an internal inductor test failure (https://www.internalfb.com/intern/test/562950131984224): `test/inductor/test_triton_kernels.py -k test_autotune_unbacked`
